tags.name: gc-segment
tags.description: One option of a <gc-segmented-control>. Must be a direct child of the control.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Reflected selection state. Selecting one segment deselects the others.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The segment cannot be selected and is skipped by the arrow keys.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted when selected. Defaults to the text content.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value of the selected segment. Also sets the default value used by form.reset().

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form is invalid while no segment is selected.
